applied.summary: Behaviour unchanged. Pinned FR-PROXY-015 AC-10 with a streaming-echo backend (head, 200 + Content-Length = body length, echo in 8 KiB pieces): writeTimeout(2s).bodyLimit(16 MiB), 8 MiB -> 504 WRITE_TIMEOUT via onError (2.28 s); 64 KiB -> 200 with the echoed byte pattern. Added a bullet to the 'Request forwarding' / '요청 전달' section of both pages: whole body sent before the response is read, a backend answering while reading the upload ends in 504 WRITE_TIMEOUT after writeTimeout, it must read the body first or be called without the proxy. Docs test written first and seen red.
tests_added: ProxyDocsKotlinTest.`FR-PROXY-015 AC-10 the request forwarding section states the declared limit of a backend that answers while it reads the body`

applied.summary: Deleted ResponseHeaderCopier.connectionNames; the copier calls HeaderRules.connectionNames (added @req FR-PROXY-011 and a note that both directions use it). Identical for every input that can match a header name: copied names are tokens, a non-token element never equals a token, and backend header lines are ISO-8859-1 decoded so no Latin-1 char lower-cases to ASCII. New test covers quoted, inner-space, ';' and non-ASCII Connection elements on the response side.

Removed copy(List, Response), copy(List, Set, Response) and LocationRewriter.apply(List, TargetUrl, String, Response); javadoc moved onto the remaining PendingResponseHeaders overloads, unused imports dropped. Tests use private helpers copyOnto/applyOnto (PendingResponseHeaders + applyTo(rec)); all 5 + 3 call sites kept with unchanged assertions.

Chose the pin test: the core bound (JsonBodyReader.MAX_LIMIT) is package-private in com.snoworca.naruserve.internal, so referencing it would need new public API. The test calls req.bodyStream(n) through a real request for n = 0, 1, MAX_BODY_LIMIT, MAX_BODY_LIMIT+1 and asserts it accepts exactly what Proxy.to(..).bodyLimit(n) accepts.

build.tdd_red: Before the docs edit, only the new ProxyDocsKotlinTest FR-PROXY-015 AC-10 test failed (118 run, 1 failed). The AC-10 behaviour tests and the CR1-2/CR1-4 tests passed at once because they pin behaviour that does not change.
